title: AgentForge sprint-NN.json
description: Cross-run sprint container (D23). Many /agentforge runs enrol into one sprint; run.json carries only a sprint_id pointer (ADR-0005). Written atomically after every commitment, split, or PM-lane refresh.

updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last write.

status.description: closed sprints refuse new enrolment/commitment (US-08-02 failure case).

capacity_points.description: Declared capacity in story points, set at /sprint-plan --open time.

committed_items.description: One entry per committed story/task-group. A split (US-08-04) replaces one entry with two, each carrying source_story so the FR->EP->US chain survives the split.

id.description: Story or task id, e.g. US-05-04 or US-05-04a after a split.

source_story.description: Set on both halves of a split (US-08-04); null for an unsplit item.

runs.description: Cross-run usage accumulator (ADR-0005). Keyed by run_id. Overwritten (never appended) on every PM-lane refresh so an interrupted run still contributes its partial usage.

burndown_snapshots.description: Optional — added without migration (ADR-0001's no-migration-for-optional-fields rule). Append-only history of undelivered points over time, recorded by the PM-lane refresh() on every dev/QA stage transition. This is what makes a real burn-down LINE possible; `runs`/`committed_items` alone only ever describe the current instant, never history. Absent entirely on a pre-S12-chart sprint file — treated as empty, never an error.

remaining_points.description: committed_points() minus delivered points at this instant.
